title: De castitate et mediis eam tuendi

heads.la: DE CASTITATE ET MEDIIS EAM TUENDI.
heads.en: ON CHASTITY AND THE MEANS OF GUARDING IT.

heads.la: CAPUT PRIMUM. Quod castitatis virtus junioribus difficilior sit.
heads.en: CHAPTER ONE. That the virtue of chastity is more difficult for the young.

heads.la: CAPUT II. Quod frequens eucharistiae susceptio est praesidium castitatis.
heads.en: CHAPTER II. That frequent reception of the Eucharist is a safeguard of chastity.

heads.la: CAPUT III. Diabolus transfigurat se in angelum lucis, ut monachum decipiat.
heads.en: CHAPTER III. The devil transfigures himself into an angel of light, that he may deceive a monk.

heads.la: CAPUT IV. Quod diabolus signo crucis cognoscitur.
heads.en: CHAPTER IV. That the devil is detected by the sign of the cross.
CHAPTER V. An example of Christian charity.

heads.la: CAPUT VI. Per unum opus bonum Dei pietas peccatores salvat.
heads.en: CHAPTER VI. Through one good work God's mercy saves sinners.
